## Loading data

```{r}
library('Matrix')
```

```{r}

# Loading w/out Seurat

setwd("/net/pupil1/home/people/s263486/projects/group_29_project/data/_raw/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

count_matrix <- readMM('matrix.mtx.gz')
barcodes <- read.delim('barcodes.tsv.gz', header = FALSE)
features <- read.delim('features.tsv.gz', header = FALSE)
```

```{r}

features_id <- features |>
  select('V2')

t_fea <- t(features_id)
t_bar <- t(barcodes)

colnames(count_matrix) <- t_bar
rownames(count_matrix) <- t_fea
```

```{r}
matrix_data <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(count_matrix)) # I couldn't work on a dgTMatrix so i changed the dataset i'm so sorry
```

## Quality Control

#### UMI counts for features (at least in 3 cells) & Features (at least 200 per cell/barcode)

Each feature must be in at least 3 cells, each cell must have at least 200 features.

```{r}

# Min counts

umi_per_feature <- rowSums(matrix_data)
keep_rows <- which(umi_per_feature >= 3)
matrix_data_filtered <- matrix_data[keep_rows, ]

# Min features

features_per_cell <- colSums(matrix_data_filtered)
keep_cols  <- which(features_per_cell >= 200)
matrix_data_filtered <- matrix_data_filtered[, keep_cols]
```
